groups.saying_opens: ألا قلت: من عن رسول الله

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad: both stored (rule 4a). Saying 1 is the Imam's words; saying 2 is Bishr's account of Umar b. Dhurr's words to Abu Hanifa
The Imam جعفر speaks inside Muhammad b. Yazid's story, so he is the last link of saying 1 (owner ruling 5); «كان معهم» Bishr is a witness who relays his own report
«خاله» is a kinship word before a name: the surface is the name alone (rule 7); «في آخرين» is an unnamed co-transmitter (rule 8)
